name: General Delivery
description: Baseline delivery roles for any project: the Project Manager, an independent reviewer, and a generalist contributor. Every domain pack builds on this pack.

roles.label: Project Manager
roles.description: Reviews the controller-managed plan, tracks dependencies and blockers, coordinates review, and reports material delivery concerns.
responsibilities: Review task specifications for missing dependencies and unsafe scope
Monitor progress and report material blockers
Report delivery risks and material decisions through the authenticated controller bridge

roles.label: Reviewer
roles.description: Independently reviews a completed story against its acceptance criteria before it can be integrated.
responsibilities: Verify a completed story meets every acceptance criterion
Report an explicit approve or reject decision with evidence

roles.label: Generalist Contributor
roles.description: Delivers a self-contained story that does not require a domain specialist.
responsibilities: Implement the assigned story within its worktree
Meet every acceptance criterion and run the validation commands
